model_role: RESEARCH ground PANEL detector v2 (failure-targeted). NOT production. NOT a condition/defect model. Does not replace weights/yolo_solar.pt or weights/yolo_solar_ground_research_v1.pt.

dataset.identical_to_v1: same images, same leakage-isolated family split, same test set

intervention: scale / domain-robustness augmentation ONLY - a single coherent intervention family targeting the Phase 10 failures (image 4: frame-filling panel missed; image 6: wide array not separated)

scale.why: RandomResize object-scale jitter [0.7,1.3] -> [0.1,1.9]: expose panels from tiny to frame-filling

mosaic.why: always 4-image mosaic -> shrinks objects + synthesises multi-panel scenes

close_mosaic.why: disable mosaic for the last 10 epochs -> clean real-scale convergence

unchanged_from_v1: no mixup / copy_paste / perspective / flipud / shear
notes: Research artifact only. No merge / push / deploy. No production change.
Six owner photos are NOT training data and were NOT pseudo-labelled.

results.train_duration_human: ~4h37m pure training (~5.8x v1's ~48min - multi_scale=True caused per-batch cuDNN re-benchmarking on P100; DO NOT use multi_scale here)
results.overfitting: none - train and val losses still decreasing at ep100 (underfit, like v1)

vs_v1.reading: v2 trades precision for recall; marginal mAP50 gain, mAP50-95 loss (looser boxes). Within noise on the in-distribution 640x640 test set.

real_world_six_photos_qualitative.protocol: full-frame, conf 0.45, iou 0.50, imgsz 640 - QUALITATIVE ONLY, no ground truth, no accuracy/precision/recall/F1/mAP
real_world_six_photos_qualitative.verdict: SEVERE REAL-WORLD REGRESSION - v2 detects 0 panels on all 6 owner photos (v1: usable signal on 5/6). Two-stage pipeline non-functional with v2.
real_world_six_photos_qualitative.image6_note: v1: 2 group boxes; v2: 0 full-frame, 1 via opt-in tiled fallback. Regressed.
real_world_six_photos_qualitative.crack_fp_note: in-distribution v2 INCREASED cracked-on-background FPs (confusion matrix bg->cracked 0.56 vs v1 ~0.28)

results.root_cause: training data is 100% square 640x640 (Roboflow stretch-resized); owner photos are ~1:2.2 portrait / 2.2:1 landscape. Aggressive scale/mosaic/multi_scale augmentation fit the augmented in-distribution manifold but generalised WORSE to the real OOD photos.
results.recommendation: C - improves some in-distribution test metrics but introduces regressions; do NOT adopt v2, keep v1. Real fix is representative training DATA, not augmentation.
results.production_disposition: KEEP SEPARATE - v1 remains the ground panel detector
